content.short: MEV Capital is an onchain liquidity and DeFi risk management firm curating lending vaults.
content.description: MEV Capital manages on-chain liquidity and curates lending vaults, setting collateral policy and risk limits for depositors who allocate into them. It is among the more established curators across isolated lending markets and operates on Hyperliquid. The curator's real product is a set of decisions about what not to accept as collateral.
